name: Job
description: Represents a single automation job execution instance

Id.description: Unique integer identifier for the job

Key.description: Unique GUID key for the job

ReleaseName.description: Name of the process (release) that this job executes

ProcessVersion.description: Version of the process package used in this job

State.description: Current execution state of the job

StartTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the job started executing

EndTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the job finished executing

CreationTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the job was created

Info.description: Additional information or error message associated with the job state

HostMachineName.description: Name of the machine where the robot executed the job

OrganizationUnitId.description: ID of the folder in which this job resides

InputArguments.description: JSON-serialized input arguments passed to the process

OutputArguments.description: JSON-serialized output arguments returned by the process
